title: Faisalabad Campus, Faisalabad | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Faisalabad Campus, located in Faisalabad, Pakistan. Address: Saylani House, 3rd Floor, Chowk, Lal Mill Rd, Factory Area, Faisalabad. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Faisalabad as the city.
